popular.description: 获取每日漫画排行（Pixiv touch/ajax API）

actions.code: (function(){function api(path){var xhr=new XMLHttpRequest();xhr.open('GET',path,false);xhr.withCredentials=true;xhr.setRequestHeader('Accept','application/json');xhr.setRequestHeader('X-Requested-With','XMLHttpRequest');xhr.send(null);if(xhr.status<200||xhr.status>=300){throw new Error('HTTP '+xhr.status+' '+path);}var data=JSON.parse(xhr.responseText||'{}');if(data.error){throw new Error(data.message||'Pixiv API error');}return data.body||{};}function text(v){if(v===undefined||v===null){return '';}if(typeof v==='string'||typeof v==='number'){return String(v).trim();}return '';}function coverOf(i){return text(i&&i.url)||text(i&&i.url_sm)||text(i&&i.url_s)||text(i&&i.url_w)||text(i&&i.url_big);}function userIdOf(i,fallback){var s=i&&i.series?i.series:null;return text(s&&(s.userId||s.user_id))||text(i&&i.author_details&&i.author_details.user_id)||text(i&&i.user_id)||text(fallback);}function tagsOf(i){return (i&&Array.isArray(i.tags))?i.tags.map(function(t){return text(t);}).filter(function(t){return t.length>0;}):[];}function makeManga(i,fallbackUser){if(!i||!i.id){return null;}var series=i.series||null;var seriesId=text(series&&series.id);var userId=userIdOf(i,fallbackUser);var title=text(i.title)||'(无标题)';var cover=coverOf(i);var id=text(i.id);if(seriesId.length>0){id=userId.length>0?('series-'+userId+'-'+seriesId):('series-'+seriesId);title=text(series.title)||title;cover=text(series.coverImage)||cover;}return {id:id,title:title,cover:cover,url:id,author:text(i.author_details&&i.author_details.user_name),description:text(i.comment),genre:tagsOf(i).join(', '),status:'completed'};}try{var page=Math.max(1,parseInt('{{page}}',10)||1);var rankingBody=api('/touch/ajax/ranking/illust?mode=daily&type=manga&lang=zh&page='+page);var ranking=Array.isArray(rankingBody.ranking)?rankingBody.ranking:[];var ids=ranking.map(function(r){return text(r&&r.illustId);}).filter(function(id){return id.length>0;});if(ids.length===0){return JSON.stringify([]);}var params=ids.map(function(id){return 'illust_ids[]='+encodeURIComponent(id);}).join('&');var detailsBody=api('/touch/ajax/illust/details/many?'+params+'&lang=zh');var illusts=Array.isArray(detailsBody.illust_details)?detailsBody.illust_details:[];var seen={};var mangas=[];illusts.forEach(function(i){var manga=makeManga(i,'');if(!manga||seen[manga.id]){return;}seen[manga.id]=true;mangas.push(manga);});console.log('[Pixiv API] popular mangas='+mangas.length);return JSON.stringify(mangas);}catch(e){console.error('[Pixiv API] popular failed',e);return JSON.stringify([]);}})();

actions.code: (function(){function api(path){var xhr=new XMLHttpRequest();xhr.open('GET',path,false);xhr.withCredentials=true;xhr.setRequestHeader('Accept','application/json');xhr.setRequestHeader('X-Requested-With','XMLHttpRequest');xhr.send(null);if(xhr.status<200||xhr.status>=300){throw new Error('HTTP '+xhr.status+' '+path);}var data=JSON.parse(xhr.responseText||'{}');if(data.error){throw new Error(data.message||'Pixiv API error');}return data.body||{};}function text(v){if(v===undefined||v===null){return '';}if(typeof v==='string'||typeof v==='number'){return String(v).trim();}return '';}function parseTarget(v){var s=text(v);var sm=s.match(/series-(?:(\d+)-)?(\d+)$/)||s.match(/user\/(\d+)\/series\/(\d+)/)||s.match(/sid:(\d+)/);if(sm){return {type:'series',userId:sm.length>2?text(sm[1]):'',seriesId:text(sm[sm.length-1])};}var im=s.match(/artworks\/(\d+)/)||s.match(/aid:(\d+)/)||s.match(/^(\d+)$/)||s.match(/(\d+)/);return im?{type:'illust',illustId:im[1]}:{type:'none'};}function coverOf(i){return text(i&&i.url)||text(i&&i.url_sm)||text(i&&i.url_s)||text(i&&i.url_w)||text(i&&i.url_big);}function tagsOf(i){return (i&&Array.isArray(i.tags))?i.tags.map(function(t){return text(t);}).filter(function(t){return t.length>0;}):[];}function collectSeries(seriesId){var result=[];var lastOrder=0;var guard=0;while(guard<20){var body=api('/touch/ajax/illust/series_content/'+encodeURIComponent(seriesId)+'?last_order='+lastOrder+'&lang=zh');var list=Array.isArray(body.series_contents)?body.series_contents:[];if(list.length===0){break;}result=result.concat(list);lastOrder+=list.length;if(list.length<30){break;}guard++;}return result;}function joinTags(list){var seen={};var tags=[];list.forEach(function(i){tagsOf(i).forEach(function(t){if(!seen[t]){seen[t]=true;tags.push(t);}});});return tags.slice(0,16).join(', ');}try{var target=parseTarget('{{mangaId}}');var result={id:'',title:'',cover:'',author:'',status:'completed',description:'',genre:'',url:''};if(target.type==='series'){var body=api('/touch/ajax/illust/series/'+encodeURIComponent(target.seriesId)+'?lang=zh');var series=body.series||{};var illusts=collectSeries(target.seriesId);var first=illusts.length>0?illusts[0]:null;var userId=text(series.userId)||target.userId||text(first&&first.user_id)||text(first&&first.author_details&&first.author_details.user_id);var id=userId.length>0?('series-'+userId+'-'+target.seriesId):('series-'+target.seriesId);result.id=id;result.url=id;result.title=text(series.title)||text(first&&first.series&&first.series.title)||text(first&&first.title)||id;result.description=text(series.caption)||text(first&&first.comment)||result.title;result.cover=text(series.coverImage)||coverOf(first);result.author=text(first&&first.author_details&&first.author_details.user_name);result.genre=joinTags(illusts);}else if(target.type==='illust'){var body2=api('/touch/ajax/illust/details?illust_id='+encodeURIComponent(target.illustId)+'&lang=zh');var illust=body2.illust_details||{};if(illust&&!illust.author_details&&body2.author_details){illust.author_details=body2.author_details;}result.id=text(illust.id)||target.illustId;result.url=result.id;result.title=text(illust.title)||result.id;result.description=text(illust.comment)||text(illust.meta&&illust.meta.description)||result.title;result.cover=coverOf(illust);result.author=text(illust.author_details&&illust.author_details.user_name);result.genre=tagsOf(illust).join(', ');}return JSON.stringify(result);}catch(e){console.error('[Pixiv API] detail failed',e);return JSON.stringify({id:'',title:'',cover:'',author:'',status:'',description:'',genre:'',url:''});}})();

XMLHttpRequest();xhr.open('GET',path,false);xhr.withCredentials=true;xhr.setRequestHeader('Accept','application/json');xhr.setRequestHeader('X-Requested-With','XMLHttpRequest');xhr.send(null);if(xhr.status<200||xhr.status>=300){throw text(v){if(v===undefined||v===null){return '';}if(typeof v==='string'||typeof v==='number'){return String(v).trim();}return '';}function parseTarget(v){var s=text(v);var title=text(i&&i.title)||('第'+(index+1)+'话');var ts=Number(i&&i.upload_timestamp||0);var pageCount=Number(i&&i.page_count||0);return {id:text(i&&i.id),url:text(i&&i.id),title:title,publishTime:ts>0?ts*1000:0,size:pageCount};}function collectSeries(seriesId){var result=[];var lastOrder=0;var guard=0;while(guard<20){var new Error('HTTP '+xhr.status+' '+path);}var data=JSON.parse(xhr.responseText||'{}');if(data.error){throw new Error(data.message||'Pixiv API error');}return data.body||{};}function text(v){if(v===undefined||v===null){return '';}if(typeof v==='string'||typeof v==='number'){return String(v).trim();}return '';}function extractIllustId(v){var s=text(v);var m=s.match(/artworks\/(\d+)/)||s.match(/aid:(\d+)/)||s.match(/^(\d+)$/)||s.match(/(\d+)/);return m?m[1]:'';}function extractUserId(v){var s=text(v);var m=s.match(/users\/(\d+)/)||s.match(/user\/(\d+)/)||s.match(/user:(\d+)/)||s.match(/^(\d+)$/)||s.match(/(\d+)/);return m?m[1]:'';}function coverOf(i){return text(i&&i.url)||text(i&&i.url_sm)||text(i&&i.url_s)||text(i&&i.url_w)||text(i&&i.url_big);}function userIdOf(i,fallback){var s=i&&i.series?i.series:null;return text(s&&(s.userId||s.user_id))||text(i&&i.author_details&&i.author_details.user_id)||text(i&&i.user_id)||text(fallback);}function tagsOf(i){return (i&&Array.isArray(i.tags))?i.tags.map(function(t){return text(t);}).filter(function(t){return t.length>0;}):[];}function makeManga(i,fallbackUser){if(!i||!i.id||i.is_ad_container===1){return null;}var series=i.series||null;var seriesId=text(series&&series.id);var userId=userIdOf(i,fallbackUser);var title=text(i.title)||'(无标题)';var cover=coverOf(i);var id=text(i.id);if(seriesId.length>0){id=userId.length>0?('series-'+userId+'-'+seriesId):('series-'+seriesId);title=text(series.title)||title;cover=text(series.coverImage)||cover;}return {id:id,title:title,cover:cover,url:id,author:text(i.author_details&&i.author_details.user_name),description:text(i.comment),genre:tagsOf(i).join(', '),status:'completed'};}try{var searchType=String('{{searchType}}'||'');var query=String('{{query}}'||'').trim();if(searchType==='searchById'){var illustId=extractIllustId(query);if(!illustId){return JSON.stringify({type:'detail',manga:null,mangas:[],error:'作品ID为空'});}var body=api('/touch/ajax/illust/details?illust_id='+encodeURIComponent(illustId)+'&lang=zh');var illust=body.illust_details||null;if(illust&&!illust.author_details&&body.author_details){illust.author_details=body.author_details;}var manga=makeManga(illust,'');return JSON.stringify({type:'detail',manga:manga,mangas:[],error:manga?null:'未找到作品'});}if(searchType==='searchByAuthor'){var userId=extractUserId(query);if(!userId){return JSON.stringify({type:'list',mangas:[],total:0,hasNext:false,error:'作者UID为空'});}var body2=api('/touch/ajax/user/illusts?id='+encodeURIComponent(userId)+'&type=manga&lang=zh&p=1');var illusts=Array.isArray(body2.illusts)?body2.illusts:[];var seen={};var mangas=[];illusts.forEach(function(i){var manga=makeManga(i,userId);if(!manga||seen[manga.id]){return;}seen[manga.id]=true;mangas.push(manga);});return JSON.stringify({type:'list',mangas:mangas,total:Number(body2.total||mangas.length),hasNext:Number(body2.lastPage||1)>1,error:null});}return JSON.stringify({type:'list',mangas:[],total:0,hasNext:false,error:'不支持的搜索类型'});}catch(e){console.error('[Pixiv DirectSearch] failed',e);return JSON.stringify({type:'list',mangas:[],total:0,hasNext:false,error:String(e&&e.message?e.message:e)});}})();
